turns.question: 按州统计 GMV 排名第一的州和 GMV，只要第一名。
turns.gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_state AS customer_state, ROUND(SUM(CAST(p.payment_value AS REAL)), 2) AS gmv FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN payments p ON p.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY c.customer_state ORDER BY gmv DESC, customer_state LIMIT 1

turns.question: 那刚才这个州一共有多少个不同订单？
turns.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE c.customer_state = 'SP'
